sample_rule: Deterministic sample from the point-in-time NSE common-equity universe using an anchor-specific SHA-256 salt; no future-return input is permitted in sampling.

trading_date_fallback.anchor: Use the latest valid trading date on or before 2022-01-31, maximum 5 calendar days earlier.
trading_date_fallback.outcome: Use the latest valid trading date on or before 2025-01-31, maximum 5 calendar days earlier.

predictor_scope: Existing frozen objective RK-MIS core only. This replay cannot introduce, tune or admit a new score-driving feature.
chronology_rule: Every filing normalizer receives the anchor date explicitly at runtime. A filing or reporting period after the anchor is ineligible.
outcome_isolation: Future outcomes are acquired and joined only after the anchor universe, predictor evidence and objective scores are frozen.
business_model_rule: Bank/NBFC and other non-industrial business-model guards remain in force; industrial leverage/valuation logic must not be applied where the frozen guard blocks it.
missing_evidence_rule: Missing evidence remains missing. No imputation, post-anchor backfill or survivor replacement is allowed.
raw_data_policy: Official-source downloads are ephemeral CI working files. Raw bhavcopy, XBRL, PDF or exchange archives are not published from the public repository.
public_outputs: source URLs and cryptographic hashes where redistributable as metadata
comparison_rule: Metric definitions must remain identical to the corrected 2019-2021 objective-core diagnostic. Results are reported even when adverse.
anti_overfit_rules: No score bands, weights, sample rules or metric definitions may be changed after observing 2022 outcomes.
A parser correction is allowed only for independently demonstrable chronology/schema correctness and must be replayed from retained ephemeral raw evidence in the same run.
No company may be removed because its future return is poor.
No alpha or calibrated-probability claim is created by this single anchor.
purpose: Independent regime validation of the existing objective RK-MIS core and validation infrastructure before prospective Runway/Moat/Catalyst evidence is layered in.
